Subject: Vendor onboarding — invoice submission options and PO ack question

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're starting vendor activation and want to confirm the best path for invoice submission for our accounts payable team. Two quick asks:

1) Portal vs email — can you confirm the recommended default channel? Our current mix is mostly paper and email right now; we prefer the path that minimizes manual reconciliation.
2) PO acknowledgement / PO reference — our AP team needs a deterministic way to match invoices to Redwood POs. Can you share the exact PO token you expect in the subject or a header field if we send by email?

Attached is our current invoice layout (acme_invoice_template_v2.xlsx) so you can tell us if any columns are required/optional.

Would love to get a go-live recommendation and any small-scope pilot approach.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — invoice submission options and PO ack question

Hi Samuel — thanks for sending the template and the questions. Short answers up front: portal preferred; email fallback allowed with a strict subject token. Below are details and a small checklist to keep the pilot low-friction.

Recommended default: Redwood Supplier Portal (web upload or SFTP connector)
- Why: automatic PO matching, idempotency checks, structured fields (no PDF parsing), and immediate acknowledgements.
- For teams that cannot use the portal immediately, we accept email fallback to invoices@redwood.com but require a subject token and specific filename conventions.

PO acknowledgement / matching rules (email fallback):
- Subject must include "PO:RW-<po_number>" (example: "PO:RW-12345678"). That token is parsed by our ingest to route and perform PO-match.
- Filename must include the vendor tax ID and invoice date (e.g., ACME_12-2027_INV_20271215.pdf).
- CSV/Excel submissions: header row must include these exact column names (case-insensitive): invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, remit_name, remit_address. Extra columns are allowed, but required headers must be present.

Pilot suggestion:
- Week 1: Push 5 invoices via our portal (we'll enable a sandbox account).
- Week 2: If portal stable, cutover the rest; if not, keep email fallback with PO tokens while we tune parsing.

I'll attach our standard PO enrollment form and an example subject token guide. Monica, Vanessa — cc'ing to confirm ops details (SFTP creds, sandbox enablement) and to own the pilot schedule.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

1) Sandbox creation: IT to create vendor sandbox account (portal) and enable CSV upload + SFTP by 2028-01-04.
2) Subject-token parsing: Engineering needs a sample email with the token to validate our regex (we expect "PO:RW-\d{6,10}").
3) Email fallback mailbox: invoices@redwood.com — we will enforce filename and header checks using a lightweight lambda.
4) Remittance matching: Show a one-page mapping doc to ACME indicating which header values map to our ledger fields (we'll attach to the DocuSign enrollment flow).

Action owners: 
- Monica: enable SFTP + create sandbox (ETA 1/4).
- Vanessa: send the enrollment DocuSign and onboarding guide to ACME (ETA 1/2).
- Hannah: confirm pilot cadence and authorized submitters list from ACME.

Vanessa — I'll also add a short checklist to the onboarding doc highlighting the required CSV headers and the subject token sample.
